description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling REST API endpoints related to project management within the Time plugin. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, along with validation rules and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: ProjectAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing Projects within the Time plugin of OrangeHRM, including CRUD operations and validation rules.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all projects with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Populates a Project entity with data from the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the model class for response based on query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a project.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for project creation and updates.

methods.name: getProjectCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption for validating unique project names within a customer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete one or multiple projects, with checks for time logs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single project by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a project.
